media:group.media:title: Van Cleef & Arpels High Jewelry × Masterpieces from the MAK Collection | GLANZSTÜCKE Exhibition ✨
media:group.media:description:
Step into the MAK Museum for the "GLANZSTÜCKE Exhibition" and discover the dialogue between Van Cleef & Arpels’ patrimonial Collection and objects from the MAK Collection.
More than 500 objects from this unique collaboration are presented across six chapters: Wanderlust, Architecture, Rhythmic Designs, On Stage, Metamorphoses and Nature & Cosmos. The exhibition is a testament to the close collaboration and inspiring exchange between two institutions united by their shared enthusiasm for outstanding designs, exceptional craftsmanship and visionary ideas.
Take your last chance to embark on a journey of discovery through the full spectrum of the decorative arts.
📅Until September 27, 2026 📍 MAK Museum in Vienna ✏️Find out more: https://accutics.li/4N5OCe

entry.title: The new color of Van Cleef & Arpels' Alhambra collection | Pink enamel 💗

media:group.media:title: The new color of Van Cleef & Arpels' Alhambra collection | Pink enamel 💗
media:group.media:description:
Twirl with pink shimmers and step into the Alhambra collection's new chapter. Continuing over 50 years of creativity, Van Cleef & Arpels now presents five new Vintage Alhambra and Magic Alhambra creations in pink enamel.
Let yourself be enchanted by a translucent and vibrant material enlivened with tiny bubbles that imbue each motif with life and depth. The intense hue was obtained using a technique inspired by the "gold-ruby" process. In this 17th-century method, the color is generated by the presence of gold particles that are invisible to the naked eye.
The result of several years of research and development in the Maison's enamel workshops, this material illustrates Van Cleef & Arpels' commitment to preserving savoir-faire.
Dive into translucent Alhambra motifs: https://accutics.li/KbRcgG
#VCAAlhambra #VanCleefArpels

media:group.media:title: Van Cleef & Arpels' Lacquered Butterflies creations | The precise gestures preceding the flight 🦋🖌️
media:group.media:description:
Delicate motifs are gradually drawn onto the mother-of-pearl wings of the Fukiyose and Akino butterfly clips through the art of Japanese lacquer. Each brushstroke reveals landscapes inspired by Japanese nature, where swirling leaves and graceful deer come to life.
Passed down through generations in Wajima, Japan, this singular expertise finds its fullest expression in Junichi Hakose's mastery of Wajima-nuri. His savoir-faire breathes everlasting vitality into the Maison's creations.

media:group.media:title: Van Cleef & Arpels' Fascinating Egypt High Jewelry collection | A shimmering fresco ✨
media:group.media:description:
Watch the faceted and buff-topped stones create a precious panorama that pays tribute to the iconic profiles of pharaohs and deities. With its new Fascinating Egypt High Jewelry collection, Van Cleef & Arpels has composed a contemporary saga revisiting the taste for Egyptian culture in all its artistic and decorative expressions.
The Paysage royal bracelet recalls the Egyptian-style cuff bracelets created by the Maison in the 1920s. On the reverse of the bracelet, gold openwork enables light to pass through and make the gems sparkle.
As a final nod to this inspiration, the back of each piece is adorned with a cartouche composed of three hieroglyphs reproducing the monogram of the Maison.

entry.title: Dance Reflections by Van Cleef & Arpels

media:group.media:title: Dance Reflections by Van Cleef & Arpels
media:group.media:description:
Van Cleef & Arpels' close ties with the world of dance date back to the 1920s. This relationship grew stronger in 2020 with the launch of Dance Reflections by Van Cleef & Arpels, supporting contemporary dance. Developed with international partners, this initiative reflects the Maison's commitment to support artists and institutions in sharing choreographic heritage while encouraging new creations.
Listen to Catherine Renier, President and CEO of Van Cleef & Arpels, and Serge Laurent, Van Cleef & Arpels' Director of Dance and Culture Programs, to learn more about Dance Reflections by Van Cleef & Arpels.
